statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
The purpose of the monitoring is to capture arrhythmic episodes during daily activities
The purpose is to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
The diagnosis codes submitted are I47.1, I25.10, I49.5
The denial reason code is CO-97
The service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
